title: SharePoint Embedded: container type creation and billing split across two PowerShell cmdlets
summary: The briefing passes: the creation and billing commands, Azure permission prerequisites and billing responsibilities are supported. Microsoft documentation gives conflicting billing navigation, access and government-cloud guidance that should be acknowledged; the assertion that autonomy is unchanged is not documented.

claims.quote: The New-SPOContainerType cmdlet will only create a new container type.

claims.claim: The roadmap introduces Add-SPOContainerTypeBilling as the separate billing-profile step.
claims.quote: We are introducing the Add-SPOContainerTypeBilling cmdlet to add billing profile to the new container type.
